# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **HarfBuzz engine and scripts**

## Highlights

The next update brings HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and completes the named script constants. HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while retaining the existing Script struct, parsing and conversions.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **HarfBuzz 15.0.0** — Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library and aligns HarfBuzzSharp packages with the new native version; the assembly version remains unchanged. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **Complete named script coverage** — Adds 30 Script constants to match the bundled native script list, preserving all existing field values and the struct-based programming model. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))
